text: How does the bank know a new merchant really owns the email they typed?
prefix: How does the bank know a new merchant really owns the email they typed?

text: Anyone can type any address, so a sign-up alone proves nothing.
prefix: Anyone can type any address, so a sign-up alone proves nothing.

text: The contract adds three calls: register, verify the email, and resend the code.
prefix: The contract adds three calls: register, verify the email, and resend the code.

text: Registering saves the merchant as pending, and refuses an email that is already taken.
prefix: Registering saves the merchant as pending, and refuses an email that is already taken.

text: A one-time code then goes to that email, from the OTP library that any module can use.
prefix: A one-time code then goes to that email, from the OTP library that any module can use.

text: Redis keeps only keyed hashes of the code and the email, and one script checks every limit and stores the code in a single step.
prefix: Redis keeps only keyed hashes of the code and the email, and one script checks every limit and stores the code in a single step.

text: The email goes out through the notification service, and locally it lands in Mailpit.
prefix: The email goes out through the notification service, and locally it lands in Mailpit.

text: The merchant sends the code back, and only then is the email marked as verified.
prefix: The merchant sends the code back, and only then is the email marked as verified.

text: Wrong codes count across the whole send window, so a lockout lasts until the window ends, even for a new code.
prefix: Wrong codes count across the whole send window, so a lockout lasts until the window ends, even for a new code.

text: Sends are limited per window, and a new code waits a configured pause after the last one, so nobody can flood an inbox.
prefix: Sends are limited per window, and a new code waits a configured pause after the last one, so nobody can flood an inbox.

text: Every refusal that lifts by itself carries a Retry-After header that says when.
prefix: Every refusal that lifts by itself carries a Retry-After header that says when.

text: Without Redis, no code is sent or accepted: the library fails closed with a five oh three.
prefix: Without Redis, no code is sent or accepted: the library fails closed with a five oh three.

text: Every failure has its own stable code, and its message in English, Russian and Uzbek: email taken, code invalid, code expired, too many attempts, or too early.
prefix: Every failure has its own stable code, and its message in English, Russian and Uzbek: email taken, code invalid, code expired, too many attempts, or too early.

text: The limits are the library's own defaults, and the app supplies only the secret, from Vault.
prefix: The limits are the library's own defaults, and the app supplies only the secret, from Vault.

text: Next, the merchant moves through a lifecycle, from pending to active.
prefix: Next, the merchant moves through a lifecycle, from pending to active.
